issues.fix: Added the rotational-symmetry hypothesis (e.g. surface of revolution, $p$ on the axis), and a sentence that the general case (Bertrand–Diguet–Puiseux) holds, stated without proof.

issues.problem: Attributed preservation of the $L^2$ norm by the Fourier transform to Parseval's identity for an orthonormal basis; the transform statement is Plancherel's theorem, and the basis statement is about Fourier coefficients.
issues.fix: Restated Parseval as the coefficient isometry onto $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z})$ and named Plancherel for the transform.

issues.problem: Writer asked to verify the choice-strength claims. Verified: the ultrafilter lemma/BPI implies Hahn–Banach and is strictly weaker than AC, so Hahn–Banach does not imply AC over ZF; Brown–Simpson (1986) proved the separable Hahn–Banach theorem equivalent to WKL_0 over RCA_0. The old wording 'needs a form of the axiom of choice' was vague and 'standard example in reverse mathematics' gave no content.
issues.fix: Rewrote the note with the precise statements (not provable in ZF; follows from BPI, which is strictly weaker than AC; separable case equivalent to WKL_0 over RCA_0).

issues.fix: Labelled part 4 as stated without proof in the theorem itself; the proof block keeps its title 'Proof of parts 1–3'.
